subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Exploratory Testing Basics
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Exploratory Testing Basics.

hook.text: A scripted test checks that login works with valid credentials. An explorer wonders: what about 10,000-char passwords?

buildup.text: Exploratory testing is simultaneous learning, test design, and execution—guided by curiosity.

discovery.text: The tester investigates the software freely, following intuition and observations in real time.

twist.text: It's not random clicking. Skilled explorers use heuristics, models, and domain knowledge to guide sessions.

climax.text: An explorer finds a crash with emoji input that no scripted test ever considered. Unique bug caught.

punchline.text: Scripts check what you expected. Exploration finds what you didn't.

quiz.question: What makes exploratory testing different from scripted testing?
options: It combines learning, design, and execution in real time
It only tests the happy path
